bullets_zh: GitHub项目tmai-tech/regintel构建用于追踪脑机接口相关法规的采集器与界面。
它聚合监管情报，可帮助监测影响脑机接口设备的合规变化。
发布于2026年9月30日，有助于非侵入式脑机接口监管动态跟踪。
bullets_en: GitHub project tmai-tech/regintel builds a collector and UI for tracking BCI-related legal acts.
It aggregates regulatory intelligence that can help monitor compliance changes affecting BCI devices.
Published on 2026-09-30, it is relevant to non-invasive BCI regulatory landscape monitoring.
